what: A 5px dot under the menu text glides to the center of the hovered item over 1s power1.inOut, shrinking to .6x meanwhile (.5s) and growing back (.5s power1.out). When the pointer leaves, it returns to the current page item. The side type sticks to the left of the item and moves up and down over .6s (no shrinking), and if there is no current item it stays off, then turns on instantly at the spot first hovered

options.look: When side, it attaches to the left of the item and moves up and down (footer vertical menu) — default is centered below the item
options.squeeze: Scale that shrinks during the move, default .6 (side 1 — no shrinking)
options.gap: Gap between text and dot (px), default 11 (side 7)
options.--fx-dot·--fx-size: Dot color (default --kf-accent) and size (default 5px). To make dots white over photos, do it in the user-side css with this variable
options.[data-fx-part=link]: Item the dot will go to (letter span or a). The current page is aria-current="page" Me is-current

use: AboutProduct

from.where: shared.js header .nu-nav (dot .nu-nav__marker) and footer .nu-foot__nav (look: side) — original navMarkerMove: x 1s power1.inOut + scale .6 .5s → 1 .5s power1.out. footerNavMarkerMove: from −12px on the left, x and y .6s power1.inOut, off when there is no current item

shared.js .sd-dots — original dot-menu: a dot 1rem left of each item moves to the current page · hovered item with transform 1s cubic-bezier(.23,1,.32,1), the dot turns on with scale 0→1 .5s (it doesn’t shrink then grow). On click the current dot goes to 0 first
